CS-1.action_stamp_note: the reclaim is a completed-bar event: features labelled causal_at_decision may read tau < 60 only; post1 is the earliest legal action segment
CS-1.anchor_event: the reclaim bar t_r: reclaim_count(t_r) > reclaim_count(t_r-1)

exclusions.note: panel_side counts are panel rows/events dropped by the case set's own rules before the raw gates; raw_gates are census-derived drops; anchors_before_gates = anchors + raw_gates; anchors = frozen_sample.anchors + sample_cap_dropped

CS-1.inclusion_rule: panel rows with terminal_censored == false, a previous bar inside the member-day, coverage_class == healthy_raw and >= 1 U-path print in [entry_et, session_end]
CS-1.matching_unit: (sleeve_day, et, family, reclaim_count, bars_below_entry_episode bucket, dist_from_running_high bucket, bar_index bucket) — the Phase-1 PRIMARY_EDGES buckets
CS-1.minute_blindness: reclaim_count / bars_below_entry_episode / dist_from_running_high are close-based 1-minute constructions; identical minute state still leaves the durable/fragile split open (Phase-1: median 1 bar, median cost -0.05%, yet 25.7% / 44.0% make a new low within 30 bars)
CS-1.name: durable vs fragile reclaim
outcomes: failed_reclaim_count delta over the next 5 bars

CS-2.action_stamp_note: decision at the close of the trigger bar (tau = 60); the execution bar is post1 [60, 120)
CS-2.anchor_event: the decision bar t of giveback:10 (panel v_giveback_10 / giveback_fired_10; the bar is located by basket_atlas_ledger.Giveback.locate_exit)

exclusions.note: panel_side counts are panel rows/events dropped by the case set's own rules before the raw gates; raw_gates are census-derived drops; anchors_before_gates = anchors + raw_gates; anchors = frozen_sample.anchors + sample_cap_dropped

frozen_sample.rule: population (no subsample: the cap equals the eligible population)

CS-2.inclusion_rule: non-censored members whose giveback condition first appears at a bar with et < session_end - 1 and which have an execution bar t+1, coverage_class == healthy_raw and >= 1 U-path print
CS-2.matching_unit: (family, block, exit_et, bar_index bucket), sides blind
CS-2.minute_blindness: the ruler is a completed-bar close condition executed at the next bar's open; the seconds inside the trigger bar and inside the execution bar are invisible to the minute panel
CS-2.name: false cuts vs genuine deaths under a frozen exit ruler
outcomes: readmissible == false and final_high_flag -> GENUINE DEATH (ledger)

CS-3.action_stamp_note: the matched state is the completed bar t; the outcome is the executable future value from next_open(t)
CS-3.anchor_event: both sides of a Phase-1 middle_decile_executable_axis pair: the same (sleeve_day, et, family, bar_index bucket) unit, deterministic side split, same-member pairs dropped

exclusions.note: panel_side counts are panel rows/events dropped by the case set's own rules before the raw gates; raw_gates are census-derived drops; anchors_before_gates = anchors + raw_gates; anchors = frozen_sample.anchors + sample_cap_dropped

CS-3.inclusion_rule: pairs built by basket_atlas_pairs.prepare/add_cells/PRIMARY_UNIT from non-decile, non-censored, non-dup_cross_family rows; both sides healthy_raw with >= 1 U-path print
CS-3.minute_blindness: measured: the best minute feature on this axis reaches |effect| <= 0.054 and is inverted (0.446 A_pm / 0.453 B600) — the pre-registered null band
CS-3.name: matched minute states, divergent futures (middle-decile executable axis)

CS-4.action_stamp_note: the carrier state is a completed-bar state; the stratum is a future label and is never a feature
CS-4.anchor_event: a bar where at least one exhaustion carrier moves versus the previous bar of the member-day: dist_from_running_high, mfe_surrendered_pos, up_close_streak, accel_1_5, bars_below_entry_episode

exclusions.note: panel_side counts are panel rows/events dropped by the case set's own rules before the raw gates; raw_gates are census-derived drops; anchors_before_gates = anchors + raw_gates; anchors = frozen_sample.anchors + sample_cap_dropped

CS-4.inclusion_rule: non-censored, final_high_flag finite (not the member's last bar), fwd_range_30 finite, and inside the top or bottom fwd_range_30 decile of its block
CS-4.matching_unit: state cell of the carriers; the stratum is shown on every number
CS-4.minute_blindness: the stratum is a FUTURE quantity: this is descriptive heterogeneity, not a predictive test (fall.json circularity tell: final_high_flag control = 1.0)
CS-4.name: exhaustion at matched state, split by dispersion stratum (DESCRIPTIVE)

CS-5.action_stamp_note: the anchor IS a print (the reopen print, tau = 0): the causal side is the pre-segment plus the hole, and any feature read at the reopen must not use prints after it
CS-5.anchor_event: the first U-path print after a run of >= 5 consecutive silent minutes (print-to-print jump >= 5 min) inside the member window, bracketed by prints

census_candidates.note: the census candidate list is every bracketed halt-sized run; the panel-side rules (terminal censoring, activity floor) and then the raw gates reduce it to anchors_before_gates

exclusions.note: panel_side counts are panel rows/events dropped by the case set's own rules before the raw gates; raw_gates are census-derived drops; anchors_before_gates = anchors + raw_gates; anchors = frozen_sample.anchors + sample_cap_dropped

CS-5.inclusion_rule: non-censored member-days with >= 60 minutes with a U-path print and coverage_class == healthy_raw
CS-5.minute_blindness: a hole has no interior in the minute panel; the probe measured 53/103 halt-sized holes carry a condition-5 reopen print and the rest are indistinguishable from illiquidity
CS-5.name: halt / reopen ordering

common_construction.capped: each case set is capped at 4,000 anchored member-windows (CS-3's number in the plan, applied to CS-1/CS-4/CS-5 by analogy) except CS-2, which is the plan's own eligible population (4,946 firing members)
common_construction.cross_family_duplicates: the 255 (day,ticker) paths held by both families are excluded from cross-family statements only; CS-3's axis drops them by construction
common_construction.selection: inside each declared cell: days in ascending sha256(day) order, each day's candidates in ascending sha256(anchor_id) order, picks taken round-robin across days -> per-day counts differ by at most one
common_construction.sides: deterministic order inside the matching unit, blind to every print feature

deterministic: byte-stable; no timestamps; anchors.parquet is the frozen anchor list

deviation_log.text: the plan states a 4,000-window bound only for CS-3; CS-1/CS-4/CS-5 carry the same bound here (the plan gives them none) and CS-2 keeps its full eligible population (4,946) because the plan quotes that number as the CS-2 population.

the plan lists five carriers; the frozen producer's fall.VOL_MEDIATION_FEATURES carries four (no bars_below_entry_episode). The plan's five are used (all panel-native) and the 4-carrier variant count is published in meta.CS-4.
deciles are computed inside each block (the plan says 'within the training block'); the block label is kept on every anchor so either block can be the training block at analysis time.
a halt run must be bracketed by prints inside the member window (leading/trailing silence is reported separately, not anchored), because a reopen anchor needs a pre-hole print for pre_halt_trend.
the probe's HALT_ACTIVITY_FLOOR=60 is applied as a member-day inclusion rule (>= 60 minutes with a U-path print).
the anchor is the DECISION bar t (the first bar whose close satisfies the giveback condition), not the execution bar t+1; post1 is therefore the execution bar, as the window rationale requires.
the 4,000 bound is on member-windows = 2,000 pairs, so the plan's 60/40 family and 50/50 block allocation is applied at pair level.

the plan's section 6 cost line says '~4,000 anchored windows' for stage B while its section 1 sets CS-3 at 4,000 member-windows and CS-2 at 4,946 firing members; the contradiction is resolved as per-case-set caps and both numbers are published.

stage_b_cost_projection.basis: window prints = 4 x (member-day U-path prints / member-day grid minutes), measured by the census; 20 B/print binary estimate from the probe's cost model; the extraction stores a capped 2,000-print sample per window

window.event_time: tau = seconds relative to the anchor bar's first U-path print
guards: n_distinct_segments == 4 and no segment is subdivided
features labelled causal_at_decision may only read tau < action stamp
window.rationale: decision on completed bar t executes at the open of bar t+1, so the earliest legal print-level action is inside bar t+1 (post1); nothing beyond +180 s and no parameter is a horizon
